📄 Estimate sent: Home Update Estimate

Hi Sally and Timothy,

Attached is the updated estimate package for the project at 2810 Unander.

As I worked through the estimate, I made a few assumptions in an effort to keep the scope cohesive with the character and finish level of the home. For example, I carried tile through the bathroom floor rather than switching to LVP, as I felt it better matched the overall feel of the space and remodel direction.

That said, this is intended to be a working package and a starting point for discussion. If there are areas where you would like to simplify scope, explore different finish options, or adjust toward a particular budget target, I’m happy to sit down and review everything together. There are several areas where selections and scope can be adjusted depending on priorities.

I tried to build the estimate in a way that is transparent about the work involved while still allowing flexibility as final decisions are made.

Please take some time to review everything and let me know what questions come up. Once you’ve had a chance to look it over, we can schedule a time to discuss next steps and any revisions you’d like to make.

Thank you,

Richard Lord
Golden Touch Remodeling
